headline: Gumoss logging boost
title: Gumoss | Wood Weight Reduction Partner | Palworld Guide
video_script: Tired of heavy wood in Palworld one point zero? Gumoss is a tiny Grass and Ground Pal with Planting level one. Keep it in your party and its partner skill, Logging Assistance, improves your logging efficiency by thirty to fifty percent and reduces the weight of all wood by forty to sixty percent. It does not stack, so one Gumoss is enough. Do you farm wood a lot? Comment below!
description: Gumoss in Palworld 1.0 is a Grass and Ground Pal whose partner skill improves logging and reduces wood weight.
